title: Validate Binary Tree Nodes
description:
You have n binary tree nodes numbered from 0 to n - 1 where node i has two children leftChild[i] and rightChild[i], return true if and only if all the given nodes form exactly one valid binary tree.
If node i has no left child then leftChild[i] will equal -1, similarly for the right child.
Note that the nodes have no values and that we only use the node numbers in this problem.

Output: true

Input: n = 4, leftChild = [1,-1,3,-1], rightChild = [2,3,-1,-1]
Output: false

Input: n = 2, leftChild = [1,0], rightChild = [-1,-1]
Output: false

hints: Find the parent of each node.
A valid tree must have nodes with only one parent and exactly one node with no parent.

func check(candidate func([]int, int) []int) {
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(2, []int{1,0}, []int{-1,-1}), False)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(3, []int{1,-1,-1}, []int{2,-1,-1}), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(3, []int{1,0,-1}, []int{-1,-1,-1}), False)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(1, []int{-1}, []int{-1}), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(4, []int{1,-1,3,-1}, []int{2,-1,-1,-1}), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(4, []int{1,-1,3,-1}, []int{2,3,-1,-1}), False)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(5, []int{1,2,3,4,-1}, []int{-1,-1,-1,-1,-1}), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(6, []int{1,2,3,4,5,-1}, []int{-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1}), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(6, []int{1,2,3,-1,-1,-1}, []int{4,5,-1,-1,-1,-1}), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(3, []int{1,2,-1}, []int{-1,-1,1}), False)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(5, []int{1,3,-1,-1,-1}, []int{2,4,-1,-1,-1}), True)
    assert reflect.DeepEqual(candidate(5, []int{1,2,-1,-1,-1}, []int{3,4,-1,-1,-1}), True)
